description: This header defines cross-platform byte order conversion functions such as ByteSwap, NetToHost, HostToNet, and related utilities for 16, 32, and 64-bit values, handling endianness conversions and byte swapping.

methods.name: ByteSwap
methods.description: Reverses the byte order of 16, 32, or 64-bit integers depending on the overload.

methods.name: ByteSwapUintPtrT
methods.description: Byte swaps a uintptr_t value, handling 32-bit and 64-bit architectures.

methods.name: ByteSwapToLE16
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit value from host to little-endian byte order.

methods.name: ByteSwapToLE32
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit value from host to little-endian byte order.

methods.name: ByteSwapToLE64
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit value from host to little-endian byte order.

methods.name: NetToHost16
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit network byte order value to host byte order.

methods.name: NetToHost32
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit network byte order value to host byte order.

methods.name: NetToHost64
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit network byte order value to host byte order.

methods.name: HostToNet16
methods.description: Converts a 16-bit host byte order value to network byte order.

methods.name: HostToNet32
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit host byte order value to network byte order.

methods.name: HostToNet64
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit host byte order value to network byte order.
